checkpoints.name: idle_before_first_byte
checkpoints.description: Reset released; rx line idle (high). Matches the cocotb-log entry 'Reset released' at 45 ns.

checkpoints.name: first_byte_received
checkpoints.description: rx_valid pulses for one clock when the first byte (0x55) completes. Matches the cocotb-log entry 'Received byte 0x55' at 82620 ns.

checkpoints.name: second_byte_received
checkpoints.description: Second byte 0xAA captured. Matches cocotb-log 'Received byte 0xAA' at 170420 ns.

checkpoints.name: third_byte_received
checkpoints.description: Third byte 0x55 captured. Matches cocotb-log 'Received byte 0x55' at 258220 ns.

checkpoints.name: fourth_byte_received
checkpoints.description: Final byte 0xAA captured. Matches cocotb-log 'Received byte 0xAA' at 346020 ns -- the cocotb log lands the cursor here when clicked.
